description: ⚠️ RESULTS ARE PAGINATED. Returns a list of sync history records for the specified connection. The maximum time window is 7 days.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the connection. Retrieve it from the `id` field in the [List All Connections](https://fivetran.com/docs/rest-api/api-reference/connections/list-connections) response, or from the `id` field returned when you [Create a Connection](https://fivetran.com/docs/rest-api/api-reference/connections/create-connection).

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: The start of the time range for which to retrieve sync history, in ISO 8601 format (for example, 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z). If omitted, defaults to one hour before `end_time`. The maximum allowed range between `start_time` and `end_time` is 7 days.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: The end of the time range for which to retrieve sync history, in ISO 8601 format (for example, 2026-01-01T01:00:00Z). If omitted, defaults to one hour after `start_time`. Must be after `start_time`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of records to fetch per page. Accepts a number in the range 1..1000; the default value is 100.

start.description: The UTC timestamp of when the sync started, in ISO 8601 format. Null if the sync has not started yet.

end.description: The UTC timestamp of when the sync finished, in ISO 8601 format. Null if the sync is still in progress.

status.description: The outcome of the sync. Possible values: `COMPLETED`, `FAILURE`, `CANCELED`, `INCOMPLETE`, `RESCHEDULED`, `PAUSED`.

reason.description: The failure reason if the sync did not complete successfully. Omitted if the sync completed without errors.

stages.description: The data volume processed in each stage of the sync pipeline.

extract.description: Data volume metrics for the extract stage, in which data is read from the source system.

volume.description: The volume of data processed in this stage, in megabytes. Null if volume data is not available for this stage.

process.description: Data volume metrics for the process stage, in which data is transformed and prepared for loading.

volume.description: The volume of data processed in this stage, in megabytes. Null if volume data is not available for this stage.

load.description: Data volume metrics for the load stage, in which data is written to the destination.

volume.description: The volume of data processed in this stage, in megabytes. Null if volume data is not available for this stage.

sync_id.description: The unique identifier of the sync.

next_cursor.description: The value of the cursor parameter for the next page
